text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Your glasses are quite large, aren't they, 
Ikuno-san? Aren't they heavy?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's made from a light material. 
Besides, it's always been this shape and 
size since the old days, so it doesn't 
really bother me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Just by being so large, it feels 
like it broadens one's horizons as well, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My field of vision... I see, now that you 
mention it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I've never really thought about it deeply 
before. ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...While I would need to compare them 
with other glasses to see the differences 
in size, I see your point."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Without the frame getting in the way, I 
can see your face very clearly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(...To be shaken by something like this. 
It has thrown me completely out of sorts.)
